description: On the tip, raise the batch size from 1024 to 1536 at 6.5 epochs (~212 steps instead of ~319), with all schedules scaled to the step count. The Muon lr stays at 0.16 (normalized updates). Scale the SGD group (BN biases, whitening bias, head) as batch size requires: if the code already uses airbench's per-example lr normalization (lr/bs), keep the configured values; otherwise scale the SGD lr x1.5 and keep lr*wd constant. Lookahead syncs every 5 steps as before. Warm up the new full and partial batch shapes in build().
